scene_context_seed.runtime_note: HARD REVEAL BOUNDARY: no early map rubbing, no mural, no six-channel human-use imagery, no Wayfinder recognition/significance, no ancient-network explanation, no Prime/Last Sentinel/bearer information, and no claim about what the Black Host expects to find. Dialogue occurs only at secured or deliberately paused stops. Torren may read visible ground/construction after seeing it, but may not display prior knowledge of the ruin.
